text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, you're exaggerating so much, 
Trainer-san. Falco's totally fine, you 
know~."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
*Yawn*... Well, I'm just about getting 
sleepy, so maybe I'll turn in. 
Nighty-night☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... All these legendary idols rushed 
over for today~!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The idol of dinosaurs, Mr. Tyrannosaurus! 
The idol of fossils, Mr. Ammonite!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Thanks for coming to Falco's tour☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Catch me with your big love☆ The ultimate 
Umadol♪ Sprinting right through the 
Jurassic and Cretaceous periods☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah. I feel like I was just having an 
incredible dream..."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I think I'm all fired up now☆ All 
righty, time to give it my all~♪"

Smart Falcon forgot the contents of her 
dream, but she looked completely 
refreshed.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hauu~... To think I'd be brought all the 
way out to the middle of nowhere just for 
supplementary lessons...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, I might never be able to go 
home?! I gotta get outta here fast~!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaa~!? The textbooks are chasing after 
me~!? I-I gotta outrun theeeem~~~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hau~... Thank goodness it was just a 
dream~☆

Having run a massive runaway lead in her 
dream, Smart Falcon couldn't shake off her 
fatigue...
